title: Great for room decor
text: Great for room decor. I got these lights for my teenage daughter to use in her room. She likes to hide out in the dark, so I figured these would help make it feel less like a depressing cave. They seem to work great, easy to hang up and just take three AA batteries and the wire feels sturdy. Only complaint I have is that they were kind of tricky to untangle out of the box, not unlike Christmas lights.
